a:r.a:t: Peptides to the ER and Beyond

p:cNvPr.descr: Eukaryotic proteins are directed with the appropriate signals to the endoplasmic reticulum. This image has a thick green mRNA line as its base. The line begins on the top right with a 5’ cap in red, then turns green and extends left, the circles down and right and extends right. To the right of the end of the line is AAA(A)n3’. One the outside of this are curved arrows forming an oval, pointing to subunit images that begin as upright, then as it wraps down and around they become inverted. Just to the top of where the mRNA line begins is an arrow pointing left as step 1. It points to a large pink subunit bonded to the top of a small blue subunit sitting on the mRNA line, and labeled as GUA. To the left is an arrow pointing to the same subunit with an orange and blue wavy line representing the signal sequence. From here the arrow curves down to a sideways version of the subunits as step 2, with this one have a coiled blue line from the small subunit going through the large subunit, then turns orange as it leaves the subunit on top. From here, an arrow points down and right as step 3. This has a green cylinder on the left labeled as SRP. This arrow points to a replica of the previous one, but the green cylinder extends up from the left side of the large subunit. Just below this are two brown tubes with ovals below. The tubes are labeled as ribosome receptor, and the ovals are labeled as peptide translocation complex, and the tan tube is the SRP receptor. To the right of this is an arrow pointing to another subunit image as step 4. This arrow has GTP joining it. This subunit structure’s blue coil is straight until it comes out of the large subunit, then coils. At the top it is orange. One both sides of the straight line are two brown tubes with ovals and the tan tube described above. On the left brown oval is a blue-shaped diamond, labeled as signal peptidase. From here, and arrow points up and inside the mRNA line as step 5. This also has an arrow jutting right to GDP [plus] Pi. This points to the third subunit already describe. In the middle of this arrow is the green cylinder. Another arrow from the fifth subunit just describe also extends right as step 6 to another subunit image. This is the same as the previous one, but the blue coil extends down to form a V, then has a blue-shaded diamond. To the right is the orange top broken away. This is step 7. The coils in this and the previous subunit extend down to a long oval representing the ER lumen, where the V-shaped coil is sitting by itself. Surrounding this is the endoplasmic reticulum, which has the ribosome and SRP receptors as well as the peptide translocation complex sitting on it. From the image in step 7, an arrow extends up and right as step 8 to the large and small subunits separated. From here, an arrow points up to the top of the mRNA line as step 9.
